specialization: Sunstead pins Bert Dobbelaere’s SorterHunter optimal sorting-network benchmarks for n = 9..16 (including Sort_10_29_8.json, Sort_13_45_10.json, Sort_16_60_10.json, and sorting_networks.html) and formalizes comparator-network semantics, Knuth’s Zero-One Principle, and a bit-sliced kernel evaluator in pure Lean 4.36.0. Each track starts from a textbook Batcher odd-even merge-exchange seed and challenges contributors to minimize comparator count.

checks.upstream_anchor: Smallest and fastest sorting networks for a given number of inputs
